info.name: Superion S1 API — Punky Tiger Labs
info.description:
Calibrated decisions in one call: yes/no (`noul`), `choice` and `score` probabilities, no text generation, sub-second.

**#1 of 214 on S1MB English v1 — Task Average 75.06 · Borda 89.82 (12 Nov 2026)** — [leaderboard](https://huggingface.co/datasets/hotchpotch/s1mb-result).

1. Get a free key (20 M input tokens/day) at https://punkytigerlabs.com/s1/
2. Set the collection variable `apiKey` (or a Postman environment) to your key `s1k_…`.
3. Send *Support ticket*.

Prepaid: 0.042 USD per million input tokens, output free. Docs: https://punkytigerlabs.com/s1/docs
